judgments.clause_name: Annex I, 14. Waiver of jury trial

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A single sentence whose reach is unclear: "all Transactions in effect as of the date hereof" retroactively subjects pre-existing trades to this Agreement without specifying which of their terms survive.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It pulls against Paragraph 14, which supersedes prior general terms and conditions, and against 3(b)/Annex I paragraph 3 on the priority of earlier Confirmations, leaving the treatment of legacy Transactions genuinely uncertain.
judgments.clause_name: Annex I, 15. Coverage of existing Transactions
